With the move to the new Cloudflare WASM-powered platform, one of the key features I wanted to add was first-class support for audio. This means embedding narration or podcast episodes right into the posts!

## Audio Example

Here is a quick example of embedding an HTML5 audio player directly within the markdown content. We can style it with custom SCSS to match the dark theme.

Using our new shortcode, it's easier than ever:

{{< audio "https://www.w3schools.com/html/horse.mp3" title="Sample Horse Audio" >}}

*Note: The audio above is a sample file.*

In the future, I plan to include full audio narrations of my essays and book chapters, bringing a richer multimedia experience to the site.
